policy: Stable PA identifiers name ownership; this ordered dependency graph determines implementation and component-release order. Component implementation is separate from publication and whole-PA completion.

units.title: Crate identities and declaration metadata
units.scope: Finite identity, namespace and signature-only schemas; excludes completed values and executable bodies.
units.exit: Publish nonempty header round-trip text cases, identity/collision negatives and original schema compatibility.

units.title: Canonical operator and indexing kernels
units.scope: Qualified canonical operators/comparisons/indexing/assignment and nominal constructor protocols; actual source dispatch and remaining library/coercion forms continue separately.
units.exit: Publish existing finite kernel text/native cases without treating unsupported source comparisons as expected Rust rejections.

units.title: Unsafe permission and native places
units.scope: Lexical permissions and required unsafe-policy warning diagnostics, raw/static places, unions and packed native access; excludes symbolic CTFE and full interior-mutation validity.
units.exit: Publish the finite native place/lint contract and independently checked positive/negative/native fixtures.

units.title: Local C ABI and linkage
units.scope: Qualified fixed/scalar and aligned nonempty repr(C) ABI, callbacks, linkage/storage and variadic callers on pinned x86-64; excludes broader representations and metadata.
units.exit: Publish exact C object/native and text matrices; retained unsupported representations remain in ffi-closure.

units.title: Local compiler declarations and attribute authority
units.scope: Local source lang/diagnostic/builtin identities, declaration signatures, feature/cfg origins and bounded attribute/lint ownership; excludes executing their bodies.
units.exit: Close LIB-046 storage growth; independently check genuine declarations and wrong/missing/duplicate owners.

units.title: Typed constant machine and inspection
units.scope: Ordinary const eligibility, bounded typed CFG execution and deterministic inspection for implemented closed values/queries. Open queries, symbolic memory and const closures have separate units.
units.exit: Publish ordinary const source/inspection cases, reached faults, recursion/work/storage limits and native constants.

units.title: Runtime memory and scalar volatile kernels
units.scope: Qualified canonical native transfers and scalar/thin volatile profile, independently of const permission or actual source-library dispatch.
units.exit: Publish effect/alignment/overlap/volatile and actual native controls against locked backend.

units.title: Core AtomicU32 protocol
units.scope: Qualified U32 load/store/exchange/CAS/order protocol; excludes other widths, full accessors/fences and general concurrency claims.
units.exit: Publish finite ordering/CAS/native matrix and invalid-order negatives.

units.title: Core iteration and residual protocols
units.scope: Qualified user/slice/range iteration and local Try/FromResidual control flow. Full iterator/library and imported source closure remain required.
units.exit: Publish actual local protocol source/native and control/drop cases; preserve every remaining iterator and imported-family requirement.

units.title: Interior mutation and wide-value validity
units.scope: UnsafeCell/shared-derived permissions, validity lints, raw slices/ranges and reconstructed wide values.
units.exit: Close retained valid unsupported cases with ordinary proof, memory and native opponents.

units.title: Symbolic constant storage and provenance
units.scope: Complete static/promoted allocation graphs, raw/reference permissions and byte/sequence/DST transport; reuses memory kernels without granting volatile/atomic const eligibility.
units.exit: Close complete numeric/ZST/union/enum/closure/static/reference graph families and escape/validity controls.

units.title: Advanced const queries and callables
units.scope: Open/generic/associated queries, anonymous instances, source callbacks, const destruction contracts and real const closures.
units.exit: Implement actual const-closure creation/invocation/storage and retained conditional/open callback and cleanup cases.

units.title: Source operators, iteration and library hook closure
units.scope: Genuine source owners/bodies, Deref and remaining operator/coercion/iterator/Try/library methods; ordinary lookup regressions remain earlier PA6/19 work.
units.exit: Execute required upstream operator/iterator/Try implementations with wrong-owner and ordinary-user controls.

units.title: Built-in derives, formatting and panic consumers
units.scope: Actual derive bodies, nonempty format arguments, evaluation/temporary order, Formatter/Arguments helpers and assertion-to-abort path.
units.exit: Execute genuine Formatter/helper/panic bodies; no generated library substitutes or erased operands.

units.title: Source intrinsic and atomic family closure
units.scope: Full selected-source intrinsic signatures/effects/const eligibility, numeric/volatile/atomic width/type/fence/accessor families.
units.exit: Close every retained positive, qualify native capabilities and distinguish const eligibility from runtime operations.

units.title: Nominal SIMD copy layout and C128 ABI
units.scope: Qualified one-array scalar/wrapper lane profile, Rust-indirect and C128 SSE/SSEUP copy ABI; excludes vector operations, wider C ABI and representation transport.
units.exit: Publish source layout/text and the exact-source native C copy observers; keep broader lanes/widths in target-closure.

units.title: Typed target features and call permissions
units.scope: Authenticate per-site feature inputs, declared versus adjusted safety and actual caller-body features. Qualified isolated handoff awaits integration.
units.exit: Integrate a96b9b005, preserve absence/input/header opponents and measure enclosing row/map costs.

units.title: Required core assembly path
units.scope: Genuine source asm, typed SIMD operands/const/symbol facts, effects, body transport and selected-target backend emission.
units.exit: Original _mm_stream_ps must retain MOVNTPS non-temporal semantics and all128 bits in real native execution; no ordinary-store replacement.

units.title: Foreign representation and callable closure
units.scope: Remaining valid representations, opaque foreign identity/sizedness, ABI/variadic/storage and selected-target cases, including retained unsupported positives.
units.exit: Close all remaining declared PA30 representations and preserve explicit backend capability limits.

units.title: Completed constant and foreign value metadata
units.scope: Completed value/storage/reference graphs and C callable/storage/variadic schema extensions; not a prerequisite for local C ABI.
units.exit: Publish deterministic complete graph round trips, remapping, malformed-schema and old-byte compatibility controls.

units.title: Provided-body public artifact profile
units.scope: Qualified tag11/v1 carry/borrow artifact with fresh named original/instance proof and native7; excludes universal source-body contracts.
units.exit: Publish the existing finite artifact/text/native graph and wrong-owner/remap controls.

units.title: Generic and source body transport closure
units.scope: Complete ordinary/const/default/region/policy/alias/object/foreign/target body and proof-contract graph; full source structure retained, selected proofs paid on demand.
units.exit: Qualify real separately compiled providers and fresh named generic consumers with complete original/instance, body/region/policy proofs and exact artifact round trips. Whole core is the downstream integration gate.

units.title: Edition and crate build pipeline
units.scope: Original host graph/build scripts, generated source/cfg/env provenance and all editions needed by selected target dependencies. Full remaining edition coverage stays edition-closure.
units.exit: Use RustGM for every selected target Rust crate; retain independent Cargo/host observations and reproducible complete inputs.

units.title: Compiler runtime and source callable integration
units.scope: Actual source intrinsic/callable identities, runtime/const selectors and panic-abort boundary, beyond registration alone.
units.exit: Execute genuine source callbacks, library helpers and panic handler through Abort; imported consumers use authenticated transport.

units.title: Original core artifact and independent consumers
units.scope: Entire original pinned core on honest x86-64/abort cfg, every active required feature and exported demanded bodies. Unrelated broader closure is not an artificial prerequisite.
units.exit: Build the whole original crate, then execute separate generic/native consumers and record artifact/source/config hashes.

units.title: Original core-only crate graph
units.scope: Original itoa and no-default-features serde_core plus complete selected dependencies; alloc is not required for this unit.
units.exit: Execute independently specified formatting/visitor consumers against the original complete graph.

units.title: Original alloc and allocator/runtime consumers
units.scope: Original alloc, real allocation/reallocation/deallocation/OOM contracts and complete target dependencies.
units.exit: Build original alloc and execute collections/allocation/destruction consumers.

units.title: Original alloc-only serde_json graph
units.scope: Pinned serde_json with alloc and its entire selected dependency graph.
units.exit: Execute JSON parsing/serialization, numeric/string/error/depth and round-trip controls.

units.title: Original std and platform consumers
units.scope: Original std and selected dependencies, platform/TLS/thread/I/O/runtime contracts, abort profile; every actually active feature must work here.
units.exit: Build original std and execute std-facing and default-feature serde_json consumers.

units.title: Procedural macro host
units.scope: Original host macro crates and token/span/isolation protocol.
units.exit: Build/run genuine host macros and qualify expansion failures and source identities.

units.title: Original derives and attribute macros
units.scope: Original serde_derive and its complete graph, with actual target applications.
units.exit: Execute Serialize/Deserialize derive applications and native round trips.

units.title: Unwinding and C-unwind
units.scope: Full unwind cleanup, double panic, personalities and C-unwind interoperability; separate from earlier required abort runtime.
units.exit: Qualify real runtime/backend unwind semantics and cleanup consumers.

units.title: Remaining edition and attribute closure
units.scope: Full remaining2015/2018/2021/2024 and attribute cases; required earlier library behavior cannot wait for this unit.
units.exit: Close full pinned edition/attribute census with mixed-origin controls.

units.title: Remaining target and assembly closure
units.scope: All remaining PA41 forms: broader lanes/widths/registers/labels/symbols/clobbers/global/naked assembly and target/unwind contracts.
units.exit: Close full selected-target census and explicit unsupported-capability policy; no waiver of an active required library path.

units.title: Async lowering
units.scope: Future state machines, suspension/resume and async blocks/functions.
units.exit: Execute actual future/state-machine source and native controls.

units.title: Async ownership and pinning
units.scope: Suspension loans, cancellation, Pin and advanced async forms.
units.exit: Qualify ownership/destruction across suspension and cancellation.

units.title: Complete frontend acceptance
units.scope: All retained assignment requirements, whole-library/crate graphs, debug locations, deterministic outputs and scaling.
units.exit: Full assignment closure, independent/source/native/debug/architecture/Clippy and performance release qualification.
